caption:
Five days until Battle of the Tech Bands Sydney. Last year Amazon's band got their introduction from Alexa, and this year they're back with a new name, Amakazaam!

As Jamazon they finished runners-up at Sydney 2025, with mash-ups, multimedia backdrops and confetti cannons, on a set they put together in four weeks. See what they bring to Manning Bar on Thursday 8 October.
